errors.text_span: the subsequent bars progressively decrease in height
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization. While the trend holds for some model groups, there are several exceptions. For example, in the 'o4-mini (No Code)' group, the 'Equivalence-One-Hard' bar is visibly taller than the 'Equivalence-One-Easy' bar. Similarly, for 'GPT-4.1 (No Code)' and 'DeepSeek-Prover-V2', the 'Equivalence-One-Easy' bar is taller than the 'Seed' bar, contradicting the overall trend.
